p.title: CI on refresh commits failed on what the live data said, and every later data commit stayed UNATTESTED
p.symptom: 35 refresh-origin CI runs failed 10-28..11-04 (49 gate failures): esm-core news audit (10), runtime LIVE3-03 (9) and data-pipeline breadth (9) on the wall clock, scenario-guidance 'at least one staged theme' (6), data-refresh/data-lineage data age on screener commits (8). A refresh commit only changes generated data on a source commit whose full push CI passed, so each failure froze the live site until the data changed.
p.root_cause: The reduced refresh-origin CI ran the same blocking contract groups as a source push. Clock-bound fixtures read Date.now(), and live-content assertions (staged theme, SLA) judged the data itself, which the producer had already validated before the push and which a data commit cannot fix in code.
p.fix: Live-content gates declare liveData: "content" in architecture/qa-pipeline.json (scenario-guidance-fixture, data-lineage, data-refresh); on AIO_QA_ORIGIN=refresh (ci.yml contract shards when reduced_scope) qa-runner reports their failure as ADVISORY (warning, exit 0) through scripts/lib/qa-live-data.mjs, and watchdog-local twins (watchdog-data-lineage, watchdog-scenario-guidance, existing watchdog-data-refresh) keep failing on the live content. The data-pipeline breadth fixture runs on a fixed clock (it failed Tuesdays 05-09Z). Source pushes, producer pre-push runs and the watchdog still fail.
p.violated_rule: R3/AGENTS: a refresh commit is attested on code contracts; live content is watched, not re-litigated per commit
p.prevention: {R}: scripts/ci-refresh-origin-live-data-check.mjs checks every gate x origin, requires a watchdog twin and a contract group for each liveData gate, replays the 7-day ledger (each cause fixed-clock, liveData, source-defect, browser-scope or still blocking), proves the old breadth assertion failed on the 11-03 06:00Z clock, and runs the real qa-runner on a one-gate manifest: old config red on a refresh origin, new config green, source push red. It fails on HEAD.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-refresh-origin-live-data-check.mjs OK (182 gates x 2 origins, 9 ledger causes); fails with HEAD qa-runner/manifest/ci.yml/data-pipeline check restored.

r.title: Refresh-origin CI blocks on code, watchdog watches live content
r.rule: A contract-group gate that asserts live public-data content declares liveData: "content" and has a watchdog-local twin running the same script; a clock-bound code contract runs on a fixed clock. Only ci.yml contract shards set AIO_QA_ORIGIN, from the resolved reduced scope.

qa.text: v59.70: the next refresh-origin CI run attests even when scenario-guidance/data-lineage/data-refresh report ADVISORY, and data-watchdog runs watchdog-data-lineage and watchdog-scenario-guidance

changelog: **Data commits no longer stall on live content (v59.70, {P}/{R}):** CI on a data-only bot commit now blocks on code contracts only; checks of what the live data says (staged themes, data age) report there and keep failing in the watchdog, and a clock-bound breadth fixture runs on a fixed clock. refresh-data also commits the new rotation-detail.json beside data.json and records it in the freshness ledger.
